summary: SkyAI, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 29, 2026, reporting the appointment of Arthur Levine as permanent Chief Financial Officer, effective May 22, 2026, after serving as interim CFO since February 2026. The employment agreement provides a $400,000 base salary, an annual cash bonus of 50% of base salary, and equity compensation. Severance includes one times base salary plus accelerated vesting on qualifying terminations. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or abrupt change, but is classified as Management Changes as it formalizes a permanent CFO role. No special-situation deal terms apply.
